placement_note: Place attachment origin at the live body head, then rotate the complete asset about that origin by the body tangent. Do not align by PNG top-left.
seam_note: Self-shading makes the rendered seam darker than the upstream base coral. Blend only the final body station to these sampled cross-width colours. A sub-point overlap may hide antialiasing at the cut edge.
geometry_note: One continuous solidified sheet, broad 34pt left seam, oblique hollow roll to right/down; transparent aperture and matte reverse are physically rendered, not a painted hole. No floor or detached shadow.
render_provenance: Orthographic Blender Cycles render with matte face/reverse materials, transparent film and no ground plane.
project_reference: Authored as a continuous solidified paper sheet in Blender; the source .blend is not required at runtime.
usage_note: Decorative ribbon endcap. Place its attachment origin at the strip head and match the final strip cross-section to the sampled seam palette.
